NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning Attachment
1600-15 South Wolcott Avenue / 1901-23 West 16th Street
From M2-3 to B2-5

The Property
The subject property is a vacant parcel located in a M2-3, Light Industry District.

It is located in an Equitable Transit Served Location approximately 1,730 feet from the Damen Pink Line CTA
station exit.

The Project
PL 1606 Wolcott LLC (the “Applicant”) seeks to rezone the property to construct a new seven story residential

building (74’-4” height) with 106 residential units, 21 surface parking spaces, and 32 bicycle parking spaces for
elderly housing. All units 106 units will be affordable units as defined under the Chicago Affordable
Requirements Ordinance.

The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a M2-3, Light Industry District to a B2-5 Neighborhood Mixed-
Use District.

The Applicant also is seeking all relief as needed for the attached plans, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code,
through a Type-1 application under section 17-13-0300(D) including: 1) an optional variation pursuant to sections
17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-GG to reduce the number of minimum required bicycle parking from 106 to 32
spaces; 2) an optional variation pursuant to sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-Q to reduce the minimum
required ground-floor transparency regulations under section 17-3-0504-C to 15%; 3) an optional variation
pursuant to sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-S to allow a curb cut and vehicle driveway access under
section 17-3-0504-G to be located along Wolcott Avenue; and 4) an optional variation pursuant to section 17-13-
1101-D to reduce the number of required loading berths under section 17-10-1101 from one to zero.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 41,981 square feet

Maximum FAR: 2.6

Floor Area: 108,000 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 106

MLA Density: 396 square feet

Height: TVA”

Bicycle Parking: 32*

Automobile Parking: 21

Loading berth: o*

Setbacks: Front (East/Wolcott): none
North: none
South (alley): none
Rear (West): 50 feet 7 inches

A set of plans is attached.
* The Applicant seeks optional variation relief under section 17-13-0300(D).
